title: Make strict health fail on broken current state

intent.outcome: Give strict health a versioned current-state policy, compact failure receipt, deterministic non-zero exit, and Make/CI enforcement without treating archive history as current failure.
non_goals: Do not make every warning fatal.
Do not suppress or delete historical evidence.
Do not duplicate module validation rules in Make.

owned: Classify report findings into current executable, current installed/config, maintenance debt, and historical/informational classes.
Add report --fail-on strict-current with a versioned policy fingerprint, subject identity, compact receipt, and exit 1 on blockers.
Make strict targets consume the failing policy.
Prove broken live Planning, invalid Memory fixture, unregistered execplan, archive-only health, and compact output fixtures.
effects: Report command contracts and generated adapters gain --fail-on strict-current.
workspace_runtime_core owns classification, assertion, and receipt semantics.
Makefile strict health target becomes consequential.

next_action: Implement and prove strict-current report health assertion semantics.

claims: Make strict health fail on broken current state is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
